title: Quick Syrian Vermicelli Noodles
description: Butter‑rich, springy rice vermicelli cooked in a quick bain‑marie for a comforting Syrian lunch. Simple, flavorful, and ready in minutes.
instructions: Set a saucepan of water to boil, then place a heatproof bowl on top to create a bain‑marie.
Add the butter to the bowl and let it melt, stirring constantly.
Stir in the ground cumin, coriander, and paprika until the spices become fragrant.
Add the rice vermicelli to the bowl and pour 400ml of hot water over it, then cover and let the vermicelli steam for 3 minutes.
After 3 minutes, stir the vermicelli gently to prevent clumping.
Season with 1 tsp of salt, and continue to simmer in the bain‑marie for another 2 minutes until the noodles are tender but springy.
Remove the bowl from the saucepan, let it sit for 1 minute to settle, then stir in chopped parsley and adjust seasoning if needed.
Serve immediately, optionally garnishing with extra parsley or a drizzle of olive oil.
